name: @bongtu/payroll-web
description: bongtu payroll console — a login-gated single-page pay console on the shared @bongtu/client engine (SPEC §7 employer-mode): MetaMask login derives the wallet-identical bjj key, a worksheet of {address, amount} rows, one click runs merge legs (transfer10x2) until one note covers the total then the 1-in/256-out disburse — every proof on the prover/ GPU service, never in the browser. Imports unbuilt @bongtu/* workspace source directly so the crypto is byte-identical.
